mentions.name: Ultrasound Acoustic Levitation Project
mentions.description: This project builds an acoustic levitation device using ultrasound, starting with a parabolic reflector approach for the initial version and planning a more complex next version with a flat plane phased array of 40 kHz ultrasound transmitters. It is pursued purely for research and learning, with no specific application goal in mind.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on acoustic levitation using ultrasound.

Starting with a parabolic approach for this initial version, but the next version I'm working on uses a much more complex flat plane with phased array of 40khz ultrasound transmitters.

Just for research purposes, no real goal in mind other than learning about it.
mentions.author: claytongulick
